## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: At 1000-issue hard ceiling, fetcher raises SilentTruncationError; orchestrator aborts before mutations

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test references SilentTruncationError exception
  Verify: grep -F 'SilentTruncationError' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py
- [ ] Test covers same-token-twice fallback path
  Verify: grep -F 'same-token-twice' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py
- [ ] Test includes negative case below the 1000 ceiling
  Verify: grep -E '950|under_ceiling|below_ceiling' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py
- [ ] Test fails against current fetcher.py (RED confirmation)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py; [ $? -ne 0 ]

## TDD Test Spec
Given ACLI stub producing 10 full pages of 100 without confirming '<1000 in working set'; When collect() runs; Then SilentTruncationError is raised before any mutation tuple is produced. Same-token-twice fixture raises SilentTruncationError(reason='same-token-twice'). Negative: 9 pages of 100 + short page of 50 (cumulative=950) → no error.

## Implementation Notes
- Create tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py
- Test A: 10×100 issues, no isLast/total confirm → SilentTruncationError
- Test B: same cursor returned twice → SilentTruncationError(reason='same-token-twice')
- Test C: 950 cumulative → returns normally

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED: SilentTruncationError at 1000-issue ceiling + same-token-twice fallback
